hooks.name: Load Project Context on Session Start

action.prompt: This is the Expense & Budget Visualizer project for RevoU Coding Camp (Batch 14 — Ronaldo). The project uses HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript only — no frameworks. There is exactly 1 CSS file (css/style.css) and 1 JS file (js/app.js). Data is stored in LocalStorage. The app features: transaction form with validation, scrollable transaction list with delete, auto-updating balance, doughnut chart via Chart.js, custom categories, monthly summary, sort transactions, spending limit highlight, and dark/light mode toggle. Always keep these constraints in mind when making changes.
